skill.name: Mounting Dread
skill.description: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
skill.summary: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
skill.tooltip:
Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by (30 + ([[si:scaleap]]5% Ability Power))for 1.5 second.

Kindred's third Attack against the target within 4 seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional (80/110/140/170/200 + ([[si:scalead]]100% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 5.5% missing Health physical damage.

Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 50% effectiveness.
Missing health damage is capped at 200 against jungle monsters.

skill.name: Wolf's Frenzy
skill.description: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.
skill.summary: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.
skill.tooltip:
Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to (47 ~ 81[[si:scalelevel]]) Health based on their missing Health.

Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal (25/30/35/40/45 + ([[si:scalead]]20% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]20% Ability Power)) plus 2.5% current Health magic damage.

Wolf strikes faster based on Kindred's Attack Speed. Against jungle monsters, Wolf deals 65% increased damage and Slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

skill.name: Path Maker
skill.description:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
skill.summary:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
skill.tooltip:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for 0.4-1.0s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by 25%. Then, he rams forward, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + (8% + ([[si:scalearmor]]2% per 100 bonus Armor) + ([[si:scalemr]]2% per 100 bonus Magic Resist)) max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for 0.5-1.75s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional 10-80% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to 70% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.

Maximum effect is reached at 90% charge time.
Maximum of 180/260/340/420/500 damage against monsters.

skill.name: Lilting Lullaby
skill.description: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
skill.summary: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
skill.tooltip:
Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for 1.5 seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for 2.5/2.75/3 seconds.

When awakened by damage, they take an additional (100/150/200 + ([[si:scaleap]]40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Drowsy units are slowed over the duration, and fall Asleep afterwards.
Asleep units can't move or act until damaged by an enemy with non-periodic damage.

skill.name: Realm of Death
skill.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.
skill.summary: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.
skill.tooltip:
Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for 7s, stealing 10% of their core stats for the duration.

If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.

Core stats stolen include: Ability Power, Attack Damage, Attack Speed, Armor, Magic Resist, and Maximum Health.

skill.name: Obliterate
skill.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.
skill.summary: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.
skill.tooltip: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (0 ~ 63[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scalead]]120% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]70% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased to (80/115/150/185/220 + (0 ~ 63[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scalead]]120% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]70% Ability Power)) × 1.3/1.35/1.4/1.45/1.5 if it hits only a single enemy.

skill.name: Vision of Empire
skill.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
skill.summary: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
skill.tooltip:
Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals (70/115/160/205/250 + ([[si:scaleap]]60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for 6 seconds.

Deals (35/57.5/80/102.5/125 + ([[si:scaleap]]30% Ability Power)) damage instead to minions.

skill.name: Tumble
skill.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.
skill.summary: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.
skill.tooltip:
Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional (([[si:scalead]]75/85/95/105/115% Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]50% Ability Power)) physical damage on her next Attack.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

passive.name: Drakehound's Step
passive.description:
When Ambessa is casting an Ability, issuing a Move or Attack order will cause her to dash in that direction after the Ability finishes.

Each cast initiation grants her a charge for 4 seconds (max: 3). While Ambessa has a charge, she gains 75 Attack Range and 50% Attack Speed. Attacks consume a charge to deal ((5 ~ 25[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scalead]]20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and restore (40 ~ 70[[si:scalelevel]]) Energy.
passive.summary: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

skill.name: Pale Cascade
skill.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.
skill.summary: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.
skill.tooltip:
Diana creates three orbiting spheres for 5 seconds that explode on contact, each dealing (20/32/44/56/68 + ([[si:scaleap]]18% Ability Power)) magic damage, up to a max of (60/96/132/168/204 + ([[si:scaleap]]54% Ability Power)) damage.

Diana also gains (45/60/75/90/105 + ([[si:scaleap]]30% Ability Power) + ([[si:scalehealth]]14% bonus Health)) Shield for the same duration. When the last sphere detonates, she gains an additional (45/60/75/90/105 + ([[si:scaleap]]30% Ability Power) + ([[si:scalehealth]]14% bonus Health)) Shield and refreshes the duration.

skill.name: Lightning Rush
skill.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.
skill.summary: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.
skill.tooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining 100% Move Speed, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + ([[si:scaleap]]80% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for 2 seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains 40 Energy.

After this ability ends, Kennen gains 50/60/70/80/90% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by 1 second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.

Ghosted units can pass through other units.
Deals 65% damage to minions and jungle monsters.
Duration cannot be extended beyond its initial value.

skill.name: Tangle-Barbs
skill.description: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.
skill.summary: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.
skill.tooltip:
Neeko slings a tangle that deals (80/115/150/185/220 + ([[si:scaleap]]65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Roots for 0.7/0.9/1.1/1.3/1.5 seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.description:
Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice, which improves Smolder's basic Abilities.
Super Scorcher Breath: Deal an additional 0.25 magic damage and gain new effects at 25, 125, and 225 stacks.Achooo!: Explosions deal an additional 0.55 magic damage.Flap, Flap, Flap: Each hit deals an additional 0.08 magic damage and gain an extra bolt every 100 stacks.
passive.summary: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

skill.name: MMOOOMMMM!
skill.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
skill.summary: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
skill.tooltip:
Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing (150/250/350 + ([[si:scalead]]100% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]100% Ability Power)) physical damage. Enemies in the center take (225/375/525 + ([[si:scalead]]150% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]150% Ability Power)) physical damage instead and are Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

Smolder's mom heals her son for (100/175/250 + ([[si:scalead]]75% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]75% Ability Power)) Health if she hits him.

Deals 50% damage to minions and monsters.

skill.name: Tongue Lash
skill.description:
Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.

Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.
skill.summary:
Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.

Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.
skill.tooltip:
Deals (75/120/165/210/255 + ([[si:scaleap]]100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

On champion hit, heals Tahm for 10/20/30/40/50 + 5/5.5/6/6.5/7% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing ((5 ~ 60[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scalehealth]]4% bonus Health) + ([[si:scaleap]]0% Ability Power)) extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they will also be Stunned for 1.5 seconds, consuming the stacks.

Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them.

Tongue Lash's range increases with Tahm Kench's size

skill.name: Cultivation of Spirit
skill.description: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.
skill.summary: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.
skill.tooltip:
Passive: Yunara deal (3/8/13/18/23 + ([[si:scaleap]]20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit and attacking grants 1 Unleash (2 Unleash for champions).

Active: Yunara consumes 8 Unleash and for 5 seconds gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and deals an additional (3/8/13/18/23 + ([[si:scaleap]]20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit. During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them ([[si:scalead]]30% Attack Damage) physical damage.

Transcendent State: This Ability is instantly activated for 15 seconds.

Spread Attacks can Strike Critically and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness. Damage from spread Attacks deal 250% damage to minions below 30% Health.

skill.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
skill.description: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.
skill.summary: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.
skill.tooltip:
Yunara lets rip a prayer bead that deals (55/95/135/175/215 + ([[si:scalead]]85% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1.5 seconds. It deals an additional (33/57/81/105/129 + ([[si:scalead]]51% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]30% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Transcendent State - Arc of Ruin: Yunara fires a laser that deals (160/320/480 + ([[si:scalead]]120% bonus Attack Damage) + ([[si:scaleap]]75% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1 second.

Cast time scales with permanent Attack Speed (?% / 100%). Arc of Judgment deals (50% ~ 100%[[si:scalelevel]]) damage to minions and its tick damage executes low health minions. Arc of Ruin gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.
